profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Software Engineer and Architect with a broad range of experience, from front end frameworks to distributed back-end services, data pipelines, and search engines.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Corp Eng (2010-2012): Led the migration of a legacy data warehouse to the internal Google cloud
- Google My Business (2012-2014): Led the migration of the legacy merchant repository to the new Google My Business platform
- Inbox/Gmail (2014 - 2017): Led the Search Frontend team; developed smart search features in Inbox for finding flights, frequent flyer numbers, and phone numbers in your email
- Google Translate (2018-present):  Led the migration off of the original Translate frontend service (20+ years old) to a brand new codebase. Responsible for improvement and scaling of web page translation, via Chrome and our custom proxy.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Appscio provides a media pipeline framework and a set of services which allow customers to extract text and metadata from their existing video and audio data.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
DeepDyve has developed a completely new search technology which revolutionizes full text search.

- Architected, designed, and implemented the content pipeline from content acquisition through indexing using a combination of Perl and Java with a MySQL backend
- Managed a small team of content developers responsible for onboarding content from a variety of sources
- Took a lead role of the architecture of the Infovell search engine, helping integrate Lucene as the metadata search engine working in tandem with the Infovell search technology

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: SHOP.COM is an ecommerce company which unifies 1,000+ merchants into a single finding and checkout experience. Led the application architecture, high level design, and coding of two large rewrites of the existing code base -- checkout and search. Worked with product management, marketing, and other architects to come to agreement on an overall design, then worked with other developers to code the application.  Key technologies: Lucene, Java, Linux, DHTML/Javascript/Ajax

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led the application architecture and high level design on several key business initiatives. Worked with product management, business unit representatives, product development, and systems architects to identify the main architectural challenges and design options for new site features. Followed project through by reviewing the detailed design documents and code, and continuing to address architectural issues as they arise.   

Key Projects: My Messages, Half.com conversion, Catalogs & Attributes.  
Key Technologies: Java, Oracle, proprietary eBay Search Engine

Took a key role in all phases of the product development lifecycle, from initial project scoping, through design, coding, testing, and deployment to production.

Key Projects: Search rewrite, Catalogs & Attributes
Key Technologies: Java, Oracle, proprietary eBay Search Engine

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Took a lead role in developing the J2EE services for the Lutris EAS Java/XML application server. Worked to improve the performance, stability, and reliablity of the server, debugging and tuning some of the most problem areas of a developing J2EE platform. The Lutris EAS Java/XML application server uses an an advanced Java Services framework, which allows modular configuration and fine-grained management capabilities using JMX and dynamic proxies.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: As a member of the Meridium product development team, led the development of several key components of the Meridium Enterprise Reliability Management Suite (ERMS). The Meridium Suite uses Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server databases interchangably in the database tier. The application tier is composed of COM objects running within the Microsoft Transaction Server, using the Microsoft Message Queue server for asynchronous messaging and event capabilities. The client tier is composed of both rich Visual Basic clients for complex apps, and Active Server Pages for simpler apps, with COM objects in both cases handling communication with the application tier. All data definition is done using the Meridium metadata schema, which partitions the metadata and business rules into three tiers, so that they can be applied in the client, application, or data tier.
